_comment: Copy to backends.json (gitignored). Schema is strict: only base_url, model, wire, api_key_env, api_key, and max_tokens are accepted per backend. Remote endpoints must be HTTPS; plain HTTP is allowed only for localhost/loopback. Prefer one of the approved dedicated *_API_KEY environment variables. Inline api_key is rejected unless the operator also passes --unsafe-inline-api-key (and every real backend needs --unsafe-host-exec).
